overall_assessment: Where the page has a plan, extraction is complete and clean (learning outcomes, teaching, assessment, exam sections all present; random controls are good). But a large share of offerings (15 of 16 suspects, 30 short texts of 189) contain only the facts box and programme list because the fetched page has no plan body, and one offering is an error page.

findings.description: The extracted text is only the facts box (title, English name, credits, year, programme list) with no description, learning outcomes, teaching, assessment or requirements. The packet's uncaptured page text is only year-picker labels, so the fetched page itself has no plan body (mostly status Avviklet, or early/old offerings, and URLs whose year differs from the offering such as spring 2025 -> /2024/HØST). These rows look like fetched, extracted plans but carry no plan content; a downstream analysis would count them as empty plans. The same course often has a full plan in another year (ARKROM6100 autumn 2025 is complete).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: OsloMet's studieinfo returns a stub page for course-years with no published plan (or for the year mapped by the URL builder, e.g. /2024/HØST for spring 2025); the selector #main-content correctly captures only what is there. Not an extraction bug, but nothing flags these as plan-less.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a content test in the OsloMet post-step or fetch validation: if the text has no 'Læringsutbytte'/'Innledning' heading (or is < ~400 chars), mark the offering as no-plan (empty text / flag) so it is excluded from section analysis and listed in the gaps target. Check whether the spring-Y URL mapping to Y-1/HØST misses a plan that exists under another year path.

findings.evidence: Fjern Feil:Siden du leter etter finnes ikke, eller det har oppstått en feil. Prøv igjen senere.
findings.description: The page fetched is the site's error page (URL /FADUFA/2017/HØST); the text is a generic error message, not a course plan. Pre-pass flags short and dup_code are real (this error text is shared across codes).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: OsloMet returns HTTP 200 with an error body for non-existent course-years, so fetch does not register failure.
findings.suggested_fix: Treat text matching 'Siden du leter etter finnes ikke' as a failed fetch (empty extracted_text) via a post_fn or fetch check for oslomet.

findings.description: Link labels for the reading-list and timetable pages ('Pensum', 'Timeplan' plus semester) are captured as text, but the reading list itself is not in the text; these are navigation labels, not plan content. Also the fixed header labels 'Emnehistorikk' and 'Programplan' appear as empty headings.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Selector #main-content includes the sidebar/link block with Pensum and Timeplan links.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop the Pensum/Timeplan link block in the oslomet exclude selector or post_fn; consider following the Pensum link for reading_list.

findings.description: The reading list (Pensum) is a separate page behind a link and is never part of extracted_text, even though the rubric lists literature as part of the plan. No offering in the packet has literature content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Pensum lives on a separate sub-page not harvested by the standard strategy.
findings.suggested_fix: If reading lists are wanted, add a second fetch of the Pensum URL for oslomet; otherwise document that reading_list is empty by design.

findings.description: Stray semicolons (and a '¿' character) appear in text, apparently from list markup or encoding glitches in the source.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Source HTML artefacts (inline separators, wrong encoding) passed through html_text.
findings.suggested_fix: Optionally collapse runs of ';' and strip '¿' in the oslomet post_fn.
